_meta.note: Negotiation guidance only, not legal or financial advice. The USER makes the call/chat; this connector never contacts providers.

call_script: Ask to speak with the retention / loyalty department (not general billing).
State your tenure and on-time payment history; loyalty customers get the best retention offers.
Say your bill increased or your promotion ended and the new rate is more than you budgeted.
Ask: 'What retention offers or loyalty discounts are available on my account today?'
Mention a named competitor with a lower advertised price for equivalent service and ask them to match it.
If the first rep can't help, politely escalate to a retention supervisor; offers improve on the second ask.
Ask about fee waivers: modem rental, activation, 'broadcast TV' / regional sports fees, and installation fees.
Before accepting, ask how long the new rate is guaranteed, and get the confirmation number and rep name.
chat_script: Open a chat via the provider's official support site or app.
Identify yourself and say you're calling about your bill increasing.
Ask for retention / loyalty offers; mention a competitor's lower advertised price.
Ask whether any loyalty discounts, fee waivers, or promotional rates can be applied.
Confirm the duration of the new rate and save a transcript of the chat.
talking_points: Loyalty/tenure leverage: long-term customers are expensive to replace.
Competitor pricing mention: name a real advertised competitor price for equivalent service.
Promotion ask: request the current new-customer promo price be extended to you.
Fee waivers: equipment rental, activation, installation, and 'junk' fees are often negotiable.
Ask twice: escalating to a supervisor routinely unlocks better offers.

Competitor fiber pricing is the strongest lever.
Multi-service bundles can unlock extra retention pricing.
